description: Orthogonally-decoupled IMDP (factored per-dimension marginal interval distributions), robust reachability by recursive per-dimension O-maximization. IntervalMDP.jl's flagship scalability representation, now in IMPaCT. Paper: Mathiesen, Haesaert, Laurenti, 'Scalable control synthesis for stochastic systems via structural IMDP abstractions' (arXiv:2411.11803); per-marginal inner solve = O-maximization (Givan-Leach-Dean AIJ 2000).
provenance: 2x2 product space; target (2,2) absorbing, (1,2) dead absorbing; interval marginals per dimension. Oracle = IntervalMDP.jl OrthogonalIntervalMarkovDecisionProcess on the identical model (peers/odimdp_oracle.jl), InfiniteTimeReachability, Pessimistic/Optimistic x Maximize.

measured.note: Live 2026-07-01. IMPaCT == IntervalMDP.jl to 10 digits, both senses. Semantics note (ISSUE-0022): the factored ambiguity is REDUCTION-ORDER sensitive; IMPaCT matches IntervalMDP.jl's convention (dimension 1 optimised innermost, per combination of the remaining coordinates).
